pack.title: Glimpse Alpha V2.4.8
pack.summary: Release V2.4.8. 6 change(s) in this update - see the full changelog on the Wiki for details.

launcher.notes: Corvus can now update itself. From this version on you should not need to visit this site again: when a new Corvus is released it downloads it, checks it against the SHA-256 published here, replaces itself and reopens. It always asks first, even with automatic updates turned on — restarting the app while you are using it is not something it should decide on its own. If anything goes wrong the previous version is put back automatically: the new build has to actually start before the old one is discarded. Two honest limitations. On Linux the .deb needs administrator rights that Corvus cannot request, so it downloads and verifies the file and then shows you the exact command to run — it does not pretend to have installed it. On Windows the update reinstalls the MSI, which means Windows will show its usual permission prompt. This release also follows the site to its new address; if you are on 1.4.0 or earlier you need to download once from here by hand, because those versions are still looking for the old address and cannot be reached.
